scope: Small illustrative pilot footprint for end-to-end prototype testing.
provenance: All population, hazard, vulnerability, disaster-history, relocation-capacity, service, and safety values are synthetic. Village labels and map points are approximate demonstration anchors only. They are not official assessments, settlement boundaries, hazard extents, or verified relocation sites.

riskModel.method: Weighted rule-based assessment; not an ML prediction.
riskModel.redZoneRule: Composite score at least 70 and hazard score at least 60.

hazardLayerNotice: Hazard polygons are hand-drawn illustrative overlays for UI testing only. Replace with validated geospatial hazard data before operational use.
